summary: Designed and implemented the evolutionary-NNUE approach (branch opencode/evolutionary-approach): a std-only Rust crate approaches/lifetime-objective/nnue-evolution/ with a path dependency on the unmodified drop7-rs engine. The NNUE leaf reuses the proven 8,902-feature/135-active sparse class (~572k params) as a drop7_rs::search::Leaf implementation with a documented determinism and information-boundary contract; the teacher corpus generator plays the fair leaf at depth 5 / 7 strata and records sibling-complete root values via column_values, with resumable per-game part files; the pretrainer does Adam with a Huber state-value loss under a whole-origin split plus a deployment-faithful ordering probe (d3s7+NNUE vs teacher argmax); the evolutionary driver is a mutation-only GA with paired common-random-number fitness blocks, tournament selection, per-tensor scaled mutation, checkpoint/resume, and a top-8 elite re-selection on a fresh block before freezing; the screen binary emits the population-artifact format consumed unchanged by the prior experiment's compare.py. Registered theory TH-20260825-evolved-nnue-leaf-d3-0f47e46c, frozen experiment EX-20260825-nnue-evolution-d3-bca7f330, and leases SL-20260825T063000Z-a52e0300 (training) / SL-20260825T063000Z-a52e1300 (screen) following the allocator's conservative-import discipline. The design is a direct response to two documented failures: sibling extrapolation (removed by sibling-complete teacher labels) and the CMA-ES leaf evolution's selection-noise random walk (answered by paired blocks, ordinal tournament selection, a warm start in weight space, and elite re-selection).
